title: Line review Python PowerShell safety remediation
summary: Remediates the ready Python and PowerShell line-review findings from the 2026-06-12 coordinator list, covering path safety, config contracts, media policy fail-closed behavior, publish/drain evidence, queue claims, Local API strict parsing, rename guards, diagnostics bounds, network advertising, release tooling, and focused regression coverage.
reason: The coordinator combined review identified safety and correctness defects that could allow stale evidence, unsafe path handling, silent fallback, incomplete contract metadata, or misleading diagnostics to survive into operator workflows.
behavior_before: Ready line-review findings remained open across backend Python services and PowerShell pipeline/release scripts, with several routes and tools accepting unsafe fallback behavior or missing targeted regression coverage.
behavior_after: The ready findings are fixed or explicitly validated with focused Python and PowerShell tests; high-risk media, publish, subtitle/audio, path, and network changes retain documented release-gate or real-environment validation requirements.

notes:
Final execution worker started 2026-06-12; execution order follows coordinator plan.
LR-001: promoted validation wrappers now resolve ops/pipeline/runtime, ops/pipeline/tools, and ops/pipeline/entrypoints paths and fail closed on missing required safety dependencies.
LR-001 fixed and validated.
LR-011 fixed: /api/done boolean fields now require actual JSON booleans and reject coercion before registry side effects.
LR-016 fixed: local worker completion now requires matching local_worker_result.v1 proof before completed release.
LR-019 fixed: failed audio presence probes no longer fall through to AllowNoAudio no-audio output; real corrupt/locked-source or tool-failure validation remains required.
LR-023 fixed: final-library promotion requires and copies the completed pipeline sidecar; full module has unrelated WebView string assertion failure outside Python/PowerShell scope.
LR-024 fixed pending drain state trust and Python/schema manifest state alignment for retry_sidecar_backup_failed; full real deferred publish drain remains release-gate validation.
LR-026 fixed rename apply active-work guard by reusing close-readiness ActiveJobs/progress checks before plan build or filesystem apply.
LR-002 added missing required generated-map freshness checks to release self-test.
LR-003 rejects relative SourceMovies/SourceTV/Outsource/LocalBase roots as validation errors in Python and PowerShell before settings save.
LR-004 aligns missing-key BDPGS OCR runtime defaults with Python/PowerShell contract defaults and covers partial legacy config dumps.
LR-005 fails closed when output path boundary helper is unavailable; LR-019 registry follow-up registers SOURCE_MEDIA_AUDIO_PRESENCE_PROBE_FAILED outcome code.
LR-006 rejects traversal/rooted/non-leaf scratch SafeName values and boundary-approves scratch input before destructive reuse/delete/fingerprint/copy.
LR-007 rejects Windows reserved device names, trailing-dot/trailing-space components, and invalid filename characters before output path write probing.
LR-008 makes folder policy validation dry-run by default and requires explicit save=True for sidecar persistence.
LR-012 enforces strict booleans for rename mutation-shaping fields and per-row force pipeline overrides.
LR-017 fixed: local worker claim repair now requires verified worker metadata and process start-time identity before a live PID protects an active claim.
LR-020 fixed: failed source probes now fail closed before route selection, preserving permanent no-video handling and retryable/operator-required probe failure evidence.
LR-021 fixed: ASS encoding scoring now prioritizes replacement/mojibake quality and locale-specific encodings ahead of permissive single-byte fallback length; high-risk single-byte fallback routes to review.
LR-025 fixed: final-library promotion worker is non-daemon and covered by close-blocking lifecycle test.
LR-028 fixed: JSONL append now fails closed when the requested log mutex is unavailable, with a focused lock-held regression wired into reliability checks.
LR-029 fixed: Tdarr Matrix full-run reuse now requires live process metadata with matching PID/start time; stale/no-pid incomplete runs return blocked review evidence instead of already_running.
LR-030 fixed: sample-validation reconciliation now performs bounded target scans of completed manifest rows for checked source/output tokens and reports scan_complete/scan_capped evidence instead of treating tail-slice misses as stale.
LR-031/LR-032 fixed: active progress with missing or malformed timestamps now reports stale/warning, while paused progress is treated as an operator-held non-stale state and status summaries preserve pause-flag evidence without stale previous-run wording.
LR-037 fixed: InFlightRegistry.load now fails closed on duplicate recovered job_id or source_path before installing restored jobs/claimed_paths, preserving existing in-memory state and preventing desynchronized claims.
LR-038 fixed: unreadable worker_state.json now holds new worker claims and emits operator-visible status/log warnings instead of allowing claim state to overwrite possibly undelivered pending done/release evidence.
LR-039 fixed: generated Windows firewall add-rule command now scopes coordinator inbound access to Private profile and LocalSubnet remote IP, and manual command formatting surfaces the same constraints.
LR-041 fixed: Backfill-CompletedManifest.ps1 dry-run no longer migrates legacy state, initializes State directories, or writes a default State checkpoint; explicit CheckpointPath remains supported.
LR-044 fixed: pending-publish ownership guard now asserts promoted src/mediapipeline/core/publish/pending_*.py ownership path instead of legacy app/publish/pending_*.py.
LR-009/LR-010 fixed: folder policy sidecars are ignored outside configured roots; legacy app state migration copies via same-directory temp and os.replace with temp cleanup on failure.
LR-013/LR-014/LR-027 fixed: strict query JSON validation returns 400 without command journal entries, /api/completed contract advertises query keys, and rename undo manifest path reuse is root-boundary checked.
LR-034/LR-035/LR-036/LR-040 fixed: state directory recent entries select newest from full scan, Tdarr Matrix console caps report/manifest parsing with warnings, Metrics source state streams cache counts and skips oversized sidecars, and mDNS advertising respects CoordinatorBindAddress.
LR-042/LR-043 fixed: Backup-PreOverhaul uses literal path handling for operator destination traversal; lint_naming and check_marketecture now use BASE_REF...HEAD git diff semantics.
